Simple heading followed by paragraph produces Heading and Paragraph nodes

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>A paragraph of text.</p>", new ConversionOptions { IncludeDocumentStructure = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Document!.Nodes);
```
